name: 39. Reasoning/Thinking Multi-Turn Replay — Criss-Cross Expansion
description: Expands multi-turn reasoning/thinking replay coverage across the criss-cross matrix, which was previously single-turn-only for every provider/shape combo in section 8.6.4. Unlike folder 38, every case here is expected to ALREADY PASS today - this is breadth/non-regression insurance, not a red-to-green bug pin, and a failure here means something else broke, not a #5186 regression. Group A covers the reverse direction (OpenAI-shaped /openai/v1/responses request served by an Anthropic model) which had zero coverage anywhere in the collection: Anthropic's wire has no signature field on the OpenAI side, so a Claude-origin signature never reaches the client and StripEmptyThinkingBlocks drops the resulting empty block before replay - this direction is not exposed to the same hard-failure OpenAI enforces, by the issue author's own account. Group B covers native /v1/chat/completions Anthropic-origin reasoning_details replay, fixed by the already-merged PR #4943 but never harness-covered until now.

// per-request decision, so requiring reasoning_details unconditionally

// output_config{effort:high} and Anthropic replied content ['text'] with
// reasoning tokens billed means the details must survive the mapping.
